name: AlertingSystem
summary: This EA draws two horizontal price lines on the chart at user-specified higher and lower price levels, and plays an alert sound when the bid price crosses above the upper line or the ask price crosses below the lower line. It allows the user to drag the lines to adjust alert levels dynamically. The EA does not open, close, or manage any trades.
summary_zh: 该EA在图表上绘制两条水平价格线，分别对应用户设定的高价和低价，当买入价突破上线或卖出价跌破下线时播放警报音。用户可以拖动线条动态调整警报价位。该EA不执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个价格警报工具。其核心概念是在图表上设置上下两条水平线作为价格监控阈值。入场条件可理解为：当Bid价格触及或超过上轨线时触发上方警报，当Ask价格触及或低于下轨线时触发下方警报。没有出场条件，因为EA不进行交易。仓位管理和资金管理完全不涉及，因为该工具不会开仓或平仓。该EA的优势在于使用可拖动的水平线实现交互式警报设置，但缺少警报重复抑制机制、缺少通知方式选择（仅有声音）、且没有持久化警报状态的功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a price alert utility. Its core concept is to place two horizontal lines on the chart as price monitoring thresholds. The entry condition can be understood as: when the Bid price reaches or exceeds the upper line, an upper alert is triggered; when the Ask price reaches or falls below the lower line, a lower alert is triggered. There are no exit conditions since the EA does not execute trades. Position sizing and money management are completely absent since this tool never opens or closes positions. The EA's strength lies in its interactive draggable horizontal lines for dynamic alert level adjustment, but it lacks alert repeat suppression, offers only a single notification method (sound), and has no mechanism to persist or reset alert states.

parameters.name: HigherPrice
parameters.description: 上方警报水平线的价格阈值
parameters.description_en: Price threshold for upper alert level line

parameters.name: LowerPrice
parameters.description: 下方警报水平线的价格阈值
parameters.description_en: Price threshold for lower alert level line

pros: 交互式可拖动水平线，用户可动态调整警报价位
实现简单直观，代码易于理解和修改
使用可选择的线条对象，方便用户在图表上手动调整
pros_en: Interactive draggable horizontal lines allow users to dynamically adjust alert price levels
Simple and intuitive implementation, code is easy to understand and modify
Lines are selectable, making it convenient for users to manually adjust them on the chart
cons: 没有警报重复抑制机制，价格持续超过阈值时会每个Tick都播放声音，造成噪音骚扰
仅支持声音通知，不支持推送通知、邮件或弹窗等其他通知方式
缺少参数默认值，用户必须手动输入价格否则可能产生错误行为
没有输入验证，LowerPrice高于HigherPrice时不会报错
OnDeinit中没有删除创建的图表对象，卸载EA后线条残留在图表上
cons_en: No alert repeat suppression mechanism - the sound plays on every tick while price remains beyond the threshold, causing annoying noise
Only supports sound notification, lacking push notifications, email, or popup alerts
No default values for input parameters, requiring manual price entry which may cause errors if omitted
No input validation - no error reported when LowerPrice is set higher than HigherPrice
OnDeinit does not delete created chart objects, leaving residual lines on the chart after EA removal
improvements: 添加警报抑制机制，例如在触发后设置冷却时间或需要价格回到阈值内才能再次触发
在OnDeinit中删除创建的图表对象以避免残留
增加多种通知方式支持，如推送通知、邮件和弹窗警报
添加输入参数验证，确保HigherPrice大于LowerPrice且提供合理默认值
improvements_en: Add alert suppression mechanism, such as a cooldown period after triggering or requiring price to return inside the threshold before re-triggering
Delete created chart objects in OnDeinit to avoid residual lines on the chart
Add support for multiple notification methods such as push notifications, email, and popup alerts
Add input parameter validation to ensure HigherPrice is greater than LowerPrice and provide reasonable default values

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
持续的警报声可能在价格持续超过阈值时造成干扰，但不会造成交易损失
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, posing no financial risk
Continuous alert sound when price persists beyond threshold may cause annoyance but no trading losses
